name: XCableContracts
caption: Əlavə modullar / Tikinti və kommunal / Kabel TV müqavilələri

datasets.name: odsContracts
datasets.sql:
select c.id, contract_num, card_num, sign_date, abn_id, inst_date, inst_place,
       serie, works_num, c.receiver_num, cable_length, amount, amount_eqv,
       curr_code, discount, c.eng_id, pack_num, acc_id, rest, rest_eqv,
       b.name abonent, a.acc_no, p.name packagename, e.name engineer,
       v.val_name, decode (c.inst_place, 0, 'Balkon', 1, 'Dam', 'Başqa') instplc,
       round(rest,2) rest_r, lastcalcdate, calcag, decode(calcag,0,'Hə',1,'Yox') calcags,
       discount_desc, c.usname, c.updusname, c.upddate, exp_date, p.price
  from bb_contracts c,
       bb_abonents b,
       account a,
       bb_packages p,
       bb_engineers e,
       avalute v
 where c.abn_id = b.id
   and c.acc_id = a.id(+)
   and c.pack_num = p.id
   and c.eng_id = e.id
   and v.valute = c.curr_code

datasets.name: odsValutes
datasets.sql:
select valute id, val_name name from avalute
order by 2

datasets.name: odsPacks
datasets.sql:
select id, name, inst_price, price, deposit from bb_packages
order by 2

datasets.name: odsServices
datasets.sql:
select id, name from bb_services
order by 2

datasets.name: odsAccs
datasets.sql:
select id, acc_no name from account where close_dat is null
order by 2

datasets.name: odsAbonents
datasets.sql:
select id, name from bb_abonents
order by 2
